title: normalizePromQLDurations: rewriting PromQL duration literals safely
answers: How to normalize PromQL durations for comparison without touching label values or identifiers?
60m vs 1h not recognized as equal when hashing queries
duration literal normalization breaks rule names like job:latency:rate5m
body:
Fix pattern: to compare PromQL expressions that use equivalent but differently-spelled durations (60m vs 1h, 90m vs 1h30m, 3600s vs 1h), convert every duration literal to milliseconds via normalizePromQLDurations before further normalization (rule-id.ts:normalizePromQLDurations), reusing parsePrometheusDuration (utils/time.ts) rather than hand-rolling unit math.
Constraints: duration matching must use lookbehind/lookahead excluding word chars and dots so it doesn't match inside identifiers (job:latency:rate5m) or decimals (1.5h); it must skip over string literals (single/double/backtick, respecting backslash escapes in quoted-but-not-backtick strings) so duration-shaped label values aren't rewritten; on any string/duration that fails to parse, leave it untouched rather than guessing.
Use this pattern as the template for adding further PromQL normalization steps to hashQuery.
applies: PromQL text normalization for fingerprinting/comparison (rule-id.ts hashQuery pipeline)
